input.content: Use the x_search tool with x_keyword_search only, mode=Latest. Run exactly this query: "Cloudflare Workers incident report since:2026-08-04 until:2026-08-20". Return up to 10 X posts, one per line as "URL - one-line summary (@handle, YYYY-MM-DD)". Posts only, no commentary.

content.text:
**Here are the key web search results for "Cloudflare Workers incident report":**

The most prominent and detailed incident report is from a major **Cloudflare service outage on June 12, 2025**, which heavily impacted Workers KV and several dependent services.[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

### Summary of the June 12, 2025 Outage (from Cloudflare's official blog post)
- **Duration**: 2 hours and 28 minutes (started around 17:52 UTC).
- **Affected services**: Workers KV (primary), WARP, Access, Gateway, Images, Stream, Workers AI, Turnstile and Challenges, AutoRAG, Zaraz, parts of the Cloudflare Dashboard, and limited impact on Workers / Workers for Platforms.
- **Impact on Workers KV**: ~90.22% of requests failed (503 or 500 errors) for any key-value pairs not served from cache; cold reads/writes were broadly unavailable.
- **Impact on Workers**: Overall error rate peaked at ~2% for standard Workers and ~10% for Workers for Platforms (mainly due to reliance on a third-party upload service).
- **Root cause**: Failure in the underlying storage infrastructure for Workers KV. This included a central data store acting as the source of truth. Part of the infrastructure depended on a **third-party cloud provider** that experienced an outage. Cloudflare noted this exposed a gap in their resilient architecture during the transition to more robust infrastructure. They accepted ultimate responsibility despite the third-party trigger.
- **Timeline highlights** (UTC):
  - 17:52: Incident declared (initially observed via WARP registration failures).
  - Full resolution after 2h 28m.
- **Lessons and follow-up**: Cloudflare emphasized improving dependencies, architecture resilience, and reducing reliance on single points of failure in Workers KV. The post includes detailed impact tables, timelines, and apologies to customers.[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

You can read the full official post here: [Cloudflare service outage June 12, 2025](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/).[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

### Other Related Incidents and Reports
- **February 29, 2024**: A limited incident affecting logs for a small subset of Cloudflare Workers (dropped logs in Logpush). It was identified, fixed, and resolved within hours.[[2]](https://community.cloudflare.com/t/cloudflare-workers-issues/621958)
- **October 1, 2025**: Increased 1022 errors for some Workers scripts; investigated and resolved the same day.[[3]](https://community.cloudflare.com/t/cloudflare-workers-issues/842539)
- **August 2026 incidents** (from Cloudflare incident history): Multiple smaller issues, including increased errors for Workers KV requests (resolved same day), Workers AI errors with specific models, Workers and Pages Assets Uploads issues, and problems with gradual deployments. These were generally short-lived and resolved quickly.[[4]](https://statusfield.com/services/cloudflare/incidents)

### Other Results
- General documentation on viewing/submitting abuse reports via Cloudflare (not directly related to Workers incidents).[[5]](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/report-abuse/submit-report/)
- Technical content on the open-source `workerd` runtime (the engine behind Workers), debugging with Wasm core dumps, and using Cloudflare Workflows for tasks like NCMEC reporting.[[6]](https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd?cf_target_id=D15F29F105B3A910EF4B2ECB12D02E2A)[[7]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/wasm-coredumps/)[[8]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/simplifying-ncmec-reporting-with-cloudflare-workflows/)
- Cloudflare's Workers Observability tools for monitoring and incident resolution.[[9]](https://www.cloudflare.com/developer-platform/products/workers-observability/)

If you're looking for a specific date, a particular Workers-related outage, or more details from one of these reports, provide additional context and I can browse the full page or refine the search.
